articles.title: From `git pull` to GitOps: How I Built a Production CI/CD Pipeline on a $12 DigitalOcean Droplet
articles.summary: Transformed the portfolio's deployment from 15-minute manual SSH deploys with downtime to a fully automated 5-minute CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions, GHCR, and Docker Compose. The pipeline runs Jest tests, builds images, pushes to registry, and deploys with automatic rollback on failure.

articles.title: Learning SQL Server the Hard Way: 16 Days of Real-World Database Work
articles.summary: Spent 16 days learning SQL Server from zero to interview-ready, building StC DataLab—a school data platform with normalized relational database design, reporting views, stored procedures, and backup/recovery procedures. Simulates enterprise-level data administration.

articles.title: From Excel to Interactive Business Insights with Python & Streamlit
articles.summary: Transformed a multi-year building invoice ledger from a static Excel file into an interactive analytics dashboard using Python and Streamlit. Enables instant filtering, visualization, and CSV export of 4+ years of financial data across buildings, contractors, and services.

articles.title: myRoster: from copypaste to 2-minute submissions
articles.summary: Built myRoster, a Streamlit web app that reduces shift availability submission from a 15-20 minute spreadsheet task to a 2-minute process. Features interactive grids, one-click weekly shortcuts, and automated email submission to HR.

articles.title: Security Incident Report: Cryptominer Attack on Next.js Application
articles.summary: Documented a cryptominer attack on the luisfaria.dev portfolio running on a DigitalOcean Ubuntu droplet. The post-mortem covers RCE vulnerability exploitation, malware analysis, Docker sandboxing benefits, and comprehensive security hardening plans.

articles.title: How I Tackled GenAI-Powered Data Analytics (And Unlocked a New Perspective on AI Strategy)
articles.summary: Completed Tata's GenAI Powered Data Analytics simulation on Forage, covering exploratory data analysis with GenAI, designing a no-code predictive modeling framework, and architecting an ethical AI-driven collections strategy.

articles.title: Building IRL: From a $50k AWS Horror Story to Human-Centered AI Governance
articles.summary: Designed the Intelligent Rate Limiting (IRL) System for the Human-Centered Design subject at Torrens University. Provides governance for autonomous AI agents with five HCD pillars: visibility, feedback, fairness, accountability, and sustainability.

articles.title: Building EigenAI: Teaching Math Foundations of AI Through Interactive Code
articles.summary: Built EigenAI, an interactive Streamlit platform teaching mathematical foundations of AI through live computation and visualizations. Implements three case studies covering linear algebra, calculus, and optimization algorithms.

articles.title: Does NPS Really Predict Revenue in Healthcare Clinics? I Spent 12 Weeks Finding Out.
articles.summary: Conducted a 12-week research project at Torrens University to validate whether NPS predicts revenue in healthcare. Used 27,000+ NPS survey responses and 36 months of financial data to build a Python data pipeline for correlation and regression analysis.

articles.title: From Groomzilla to Full-Stack Engineer: Building Wedstack
articles.summary: Built Wedstack, a wedding invitation web app with real-time RSVP, guestbook, gift store with Stripe integration, and multi-language support. Showcases full-stack skills with Next.js frontend, Node.js GraphQL backend, and MongoDB.

articles.title: Engineering Principles Applied to Daily Life: Concierge Edition
articles.summary: Identified a confusing spreadsheet system for parcel deliveries at a building and solved it by building a Streamlit web app. Converts apartment numbers into clear delivery instructions, now in daily use.

articles.title: My Database Conundrum: MongoDB vs Supabase for a Pure Python App
articles.summary: Compares MongoDB and Supabase for a pure Python application, weighing developer experience, scalability, and ecosystem considerations. Explores the trade-offs of document vs relational databases for different project needs.

articles.title: Scaling Fastier: My AWS Solutions Architect Journey with a Virtual Challenge
articles.summary: Documents the journey through an AWS Solutions Architect simulation, exploring cloud architecture patterns, scalability strategies, and infrastructure design decisions.

articles.title: How I Tackled the Commonwealth's Bank Software Engineering Challenge
articles.summary: Completed Forage's CBA Software Engineering challenge involving .NET backend modifications, React/Redux frontend work, and xUnit/TypeScript testing. Covers full-stack modifications including MongoDB configuration and GitHub PR workflows.

articles.title: ClinicTrends AI – Transforming Customer Feedback Into Intelligent Insights
articles.summary: Built ClinicTrends AI, a machine learning project transforming 27,000+ NPS survey responses into actionable real-time intelligence. Uses multiple ML models for sentiment analysis including TF-IDF, Logistic Regression, and Hugging Face Transformers.

articles.title: Build a Full-Stack QR Code Generator in MERN with GraphQL & MongoDB
articles.summary: Built a QR code service for the Wedstack wedding website using Node.js, MongoDB, Apollo GraphQL, and Next.js. Generates Base64-encoded QR codes stored in MongoDB, served via GraphQL without external APIs.

articles.title: How I Created a Daily Follow-Up System to Dominate My Master's Degree Assignments
articles.summary: Created a systematic daily follow-up approach for managing Master's degree workload. Shares the productivity system and tools used to stay on top of multiple concurrent academic and professional commitments.

articles.title: How I Turned a 30-Minute Daily Task into a 5-Minute Automation (Saved 105 Hours a Year!)
articles.summary: Identified a repetitive 30-minute daily task and automated it down to 5 minutes, saving approximately 105 hours per year. Demonstrates the engineering mindset of finding automation opportunities in everyday workflows.

articles.title: From Google Sheets to a Scalable SaaS: Building Konquista with Python and Django
articles.summary: Chronicles the evolution of Konquista from a simple Google Sheets workflow to a scalable WhatsApp CRM SaaS. Covers the Django architecture, Celery/Redis for async processing, GraphQL API, and Docker containerization.

articles.title: CuraNexus Analytics – Security in Architecture, not Afterthought
articles.summary: Architected CuraNexus Analytics, a healthcare analytics platform for the Secure by Design subject at Torrens University. Demonstrates embedding CIA Triad, least privilege, and defense-in-depth into early design phases.
